provenance.name: anchored-v1
provenance.note: Provisional anchoring to the published results of another machine (round robin 2022/2023, Bosch SMV6ECX51E, eco programme, detergent D; docs/research/standards.md section 7.1), to be replaced by washes on the owner's machine. Mechanism corrections (not fitted): soil.subCellCv = 0.3, soil.amountCv = 0.05, soil.heatDryingFactor = 80, soil.egg_yolk.bakeReference = 0.2, soil.starch.bakeReference = 0.2, soil.tea.visibleFraction = 0, soil.tea.visibleMass = 0.00005. Fitted with packages/calibration/anchors/scripts/fit.ts to the class means of the record, with the in-machine egg-yolk rates (soils 6.1) as observations and the IKW residues (soils 6.4) as a constraint: soil.egg_yolk.rateRef = 0.0000358, liq.xProtease = 0.0257, soil.bleachRate = 0.00121. Searched and returned to its default because the record does not tell: soil.supplyRenewal. See docs/calibration/anchoring.md.
